tasks.label: 🪟 Start Backend (Windows Native)
args: Write-Host '🚀 INICIANDO BACKEND' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '===================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '📋 Verificando dependências...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (!(Test-Path 'node_modules')) { Write-Host '❌ Dependências não instaladas. Instalando...' -ForegroundColor Red; pnpm install; Write-Host '✅ Dependências instaladas' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✅ Dependências OK' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando workspace backend...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $backendCheck = pnpm --filter '@fiscal/backend' --version 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '❌ Workspace @fiscal/backend não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '💡 Execute: 🪟 Fix Backend Module Issues' -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 1 } else { Write-Host '✅ Workspace backend OK' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '🔨 Verificando build...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (!(Test-Path 'apps/backend/dist')) { Write-Host '📦 Compilando TypeScript...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; pnpm --filter '@fiscal/backend' build; Write-Host '✅ Build concluído' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✅ Build OK' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '🚀 Iniciando backend...' -ForegroundColor Green; pnpm --filter '@fiscal/backend' dev

tasks.label: 🪟 Start Frontend (Windows Native)
args: Write-Host '🌐 INICIANDO FRONTEND' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '=====================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '📋 Verificando dependências...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (!(Test-Path 'node_modules')) { Write-Host '❌ Dependências não instaladas. Instalando...' -ForegroundColor Red; pnpm install; Write-Host '✅ Dependências instaladas' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✅ Dependências OK' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando workspace frontend...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $frontendCheck = pnpm --filter '@fiscal/frontend' --version 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '❌ Workspace @fiscal/frontend não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '💡 Verifique se apps/frontend/package.json existe' -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 1 } else { Write-Host '✅ Workspace frontend OK' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '🌐 Iniciando frontend...' -ForegroundColor Green; pnpm --filter '@fiscal/frontend' dev

tasks.label: 🪟 Stop All Windows Processes
args: $processes = Get-Process -Name 'node', 'pnpm' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($processes) { $processes | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'Processos Node.js/pnpm finalizados' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'Nenhum processo Node.js/pnpm encontrado' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 🪟 Kill Specific Port Process
args: $port = Read-Host 'Digite a porta para finalizar processos'; $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $connections | ForEach-Object { $processId = $_.OwningProcess; try { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force; Write-Host "Processo $processId na porta $port finalizado" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host "Erro ao finalizar processo $processId" -ForegroundColor Red } } } else { Write-Host "Nenhum processo encontrado na porta $port" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 🪟 Show Environment Variables
args: Write-Host '🔍 VARIÁVEIS DE AMBIENTE' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '========================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path '.env') { Write-Host '📋 Variáveis do arquivo .env:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Content '.env' | Where-Object { $_ -match '^[^#].*=' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   $_" -ForegroundColor White } } else { Write-Host '❌ Arquivo .env não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '📋 Variáveis de ambiente do sistema:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; @('VITE_PORT', 'BACKOFFICE_PORT', 'NODE_ENV', 'PORT') | ForEach-Object { $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($_); if ($value) { Write-Host "   $_ = $value" -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "   $_ = (não definida)" -ForegroundColor Gray } }

tasks.label: 🪟 Install Dependencies (Windows Native)
args: Write-Host '📦 INSTALAÇÃO DE DEPENDÊNCIAS' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '=============================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '📋 Verificando Node.js...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { $nodeVersion = node --version; Write-Host "✅ Node.js: $nodeVersion" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '❌ Node.js não encontrado. Instale Node.js 20+' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando pnpm...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { $pnpmVersion = pnpm --version; Write-Host "✅ pnpm: v$pnpmVersion" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '❌ pnpm não encontrado. Instalando...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npm install -g pnpm; Write-Host '✅ pnpm instalado' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando dependências...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (!(Test-Path 'node_modules')) { Write-Host '📦 Instalando dependências do projeto...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; pnpm install; Write-Host '✅ Dependências instaladas' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '📋 Verificando se dependências estão atualizadas...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $outdated = pnpm outdated 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '📦 Atualizando dependências...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; pnpm install; Write-Host '✅ Dependências atualizadas' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✅ Dependências já estão instaladas e atualizadas' -ForegroundColor Green } }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando workspaces...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $workspaces = pnpm list --recursive --depth=0 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Workspaces configurados corretamente' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ Problemas com workspaces detectados' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host '🎯 Instalação concluída!' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: 🪟 Fix Backend Module Issues
args: Write-Host '🔧 CORRIGINDO PROBLEMAS DE MÓDULOS' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '=================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '📋 Limpando cache e node_modules...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/backend/node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/frontend/node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force packages/shared/node_modules -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force packages/shared/dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/backend/dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '📦 Reinstalando dependências...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; pnpm install; Write-Host '🔨 Compilando shared...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; pnpm --filter @fiscal/shared build; Write-Host '🔨 Compilando backend...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; pnpm --filter @fiscal/backend build; Write-Host '🧪 Testando workspaces...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $sharedTest = pnpm --filter '@fiscal/shared' --version 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Shared workspace OK' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ Shared workspace com problemas' -ForegroundColor Red }; $backendTest = pnpm --filter '@fiscal/backend' --version 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Backend workspace OK' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ Backend workspace com problemas' -ForegroundColor Red }; Write-Host '🎯 Correção concluída!' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: 🪟 Pre-Debug Check
args: Write-Host '🔍 PRÉ-DEBUG CHECK' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '==================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $errors = @(); Write-Host '📋 Verificando Node.js...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { $nodeVersion = node --version; Write-Host "✅ Node.js: $nodeVersion" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '❌ Node.js não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red; $errors += 'Node.js não instalado' }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando pnpm...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { $pnpmVersion = pnpm --version; Write-Host "✅ pnpm: v$pnpmVersion" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '❌ pnpm não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red; $errors += 'pnpm não instalado' }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando dependências...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (Test-Path 'node_modules') { Write-Host '✅ node_modules existe' -ForegroundColor Green; $workspaces = pnpm list --recursive --depth=0 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Workspaces OK' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ Problemas com workspaces' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $errors += 'Workspaces com problemas' } } else { Write-Host '❌ node_modules não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red; $errors += 'Dependências não instaladas' }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando arquivo .env...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (Test-Path '.env') { Write-Host '✅ .env existe' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ .env não encontrado' -ForegroundColor Red; $errors += 'Arquivo .env não encontrado' }; Write-Host '📋 Verificando portas...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $ports = @(4005, 4010, 9229); $portsInUse = @(); foreach ($port in $ports) { $connection = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connection) { $portsInUse += $port } }; if ($portsInUse.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Todas as portas livres' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "⚠️ Portas em uso: $($portsInUse -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''; if ($errors.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '🎯 TUDO OK - Pronto para debug!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ PROBLEMAS ENCONTRADOS:' -ForegroundColor Red; $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   - $_" -ForegroundColor Red }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 Execute: Ctrl+Shift+P → Tasks: Run Task → 🪟 Install Dependencies' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 🪟 Clean Backend Build Only
args: Write-Host '🧹 LIMPANDO BUILD DO BACKEND' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path 'apps/backend/dist') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force apps/backend/dist; Write-Host '✅ Pasta apps/backend/dist removida' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '✅ Nenhuma build anterior encontrada' -ForegroundColor Green }
